responsibility: This file implements GCC’s main RTL variable-tracking pass for debug information. It scans RTL into micro-operations describing uses, sets, clobbers, calls, and stack adjustments; performs forward dataflow over basic blocks to track where user variables and their pieces reside in registers or memory; and emits NOTE_INSN_VAR_LOCATION and related debug notes only where variable locations change. It also manages fallback local-only handling, deletion of obsolete VTA debug insns, and final cleanup. Its product is the location history from which DWARF and other debug back ends can reconstruct variable values in optimized code.
